methods.name: Cell-gate dyadic rotation refinement / target-free Viete checker
capabilities: certify 2*u_(m+1)=iota_m(u_m) for the three-step root state
locate the first quarter-turn in the actual Cell-gate C12 layer
show reflection exchanges the two quarter-turn roots
classify Cell, gate, and higher-transition birth levels

methods.core_law: For Gamma_m=Z/(6*2^m), iota_m(k)=2k and u_m=3, ord(u_m)=2^(m+1) and 2*u_(m+1)=iota_m(u_m). The compatible character traces satisfy c_(m+1)^2=(1+c_m)/2 and 2/prod_{j=2}^m c_j=2^m s_m.
methods.hard_boundary: The first C6-to-C12 refinement has an actual Cell/gate incidence realization. Levels beyond C12 are transition/history refinements unless separately physically realized. The checker does not identify carrier directions with P000 native axes, derive a global operation-safe rotation quotient, or prove the classical analytic identity pi_rot=pi. No Driver review or shared-tool promotion is requested by this addendum.

methods.name: Cyclic gate-phase refinement / carry / Euler-Viete certificate
capabilities: exact even-state embedding C_N into C_2N
methods.core_law: Barycentric phase refinement has j=2k+epsilon and (k,e)+(l,f)=(k+l+e*f,e+f mod 2); for the coherent chiral half-turn root tower the normalized trace satisfies c_(m+1)^2=(1+c_m)/2 and its Viete product defines an increasing finite rotation-completion sequence without using the target value of pi.
methods.hard_boundary: Carrier/readout and finite algebraic layer only. The tool does not prove that every native Cell trajectory factors through the gate phase, does not derive an archimedean U(1) metric from native length, and does not identify the cyclic carry C2 with the tetrahedral residual C2. The effective_character API deliberately uses the classical complex exponential only as an external bridge check.

methods.name: Exact quotient-root atlas and ternary state-count carry operator
capabilities: compute the exact state-specific coalescence horizon and high-denominator cutoff
certify the high injective chart and contiguous forced low-root chart
compute exact distinct quotient-root state cardinality without a full denominator scan
certify the unique optional horizon state by a binary boundary carry
compress the exact count to a three-valued threshold carry
materialize the compressed root-state atlas for regression or downstream finite reasoning
methods.core_law: For n>=1 and r>=1, with H=R_(r+1)(r*n-1) and D=floor(n/(H+1)^r), the quotient-root atlas R_r(floor(n/d)), 1<=d<=n, is the disjoint union of an injective D-state high chart and the forced low interval 1..H-1 plus at most the horizon H. Hence |S|+1=D+H+kappa; with q=floor(H/r) the three-point D-band compresses this to |S|+1=H+q+tau with tau in {0,1,2} selected by two exact thresholds.
methods.hard_boundary: DOMAIN_OPERATOR only. The carrier is the finite positive-denominator quotient-root atlas. Do not generalize to arbitrary floor maps or quotient semigroups, do not infer prime/factoring/Legendre or continuum claims, do not erase the H=0 branch, and do not treat the ternary state-count carry as a universal T5 carry law. No Foundation mutation follows.

methods.name: BRC multiplier square-content scan reduction
capabilities: exact one-shot stripping of every multiplier square factor whose root divides the known BRC ceiling root
exact immediate-ceiling witness preservation under m->m/g^2 and x->x/g
same gcd-factor preservation under declared gcd(n,m)=1
canonical reuse of m=a^2 d squarefree decomposition
composition with the existing exact odd-N 2-adic state representative
state-level IRREDUNDANT/REDUCED/IMPOSSIBLE classification before gap squarehood testing
methods.core_law: Write m=a^2 d with d squarefree and x=ceil(sqrt(mn)). Under gcd(n,m)=1, g=gcd(a,x) divides the square root y of every successful completion gap y^2=x^2-mn. Dividing m,x,y by g^2,g,g yields the exact immediate ceiling witness at m/g^2, and gcd(x-y,n)=gcd(x/g-y/g,n). After this one-shot normalization gcd(a/g,x/g)=1, so all square content visible in the current ceiling root has been removed.
methods.hard_boundary: Requires an already-known exact ceiling root and declared gcd(n,m)=1; a nontrivial multiplier gcd should be handled as a factor witness before this reduction. Squareful multipliers are not statically discardable: states with gcd(square-content-root,ceiling-root)=1 can be genuine first hits. Common-factor scaling is elementary prior art; no novelty priority, asymptotic factorization speedup, or Foundation promotion is claimed.

methods.name: BRC fixed-phase root/remainder third-difference transport
triggers: reuse reciprocal table for BRC correction
capabilities: exact unbounded fixed-phase root/remainder transport after fourteen order-one seed transitions
quadratic extrapolation of each mod-8 phase root from three labeled exact phase states
exact target residual G=R0-3R1+3R2-6b(b-a) without target square root or q(2J+q)
reuse of the existing 1024-byte normalized reciprocal table for constant-comparison phase closure
preservation of the exact completion gap for composition with the zero-false-negative BALANCED square-residue cascade
optional exact lifted product state using only bounded-correction multipliers, retained as a CPU-negative alternative
methods.core_law: For phase-spaced states (m+8i)N=J_i^2+R_i, let a=J_1-J_0, b=J_2-J_1 and C=3J_2-3J_1+J_0. Then (m+24)N-C^2=R_0-3R_1+3R_2-6b(b-a). On 4m^5>=N, e=J_3-C is the integer third phase difference and satisfies -3<=e<=387. For C>=75078, floor(G/(2C+1)) lies in {e,e+1}; the existing Round-13 1 KiB lower-reciprocal table recovers that floor with at most two increments, and one sign check yields the exact (J_3,R_3).
methods.observer_contract: Retain three labeled phase triples (m_i,J_i,R_i). Roots alone, Boolean support, or an unlabeled aggregate are inadequate because the exact residual and future completion-gap observer depend on the individual remainders and phase order.
methods.hard_boundary: Exact integer transport only on the already-certified odd-N order-one deep tail and fixed mod-8 representative phases. The finite performance crossover is runtime-dependent; direct division remains appropriate for smaller operands. This does not reduce the multiplier horizon, change Lehman/Hart factorization complexity, imply RSA practicality, or create a new top-level BRC family.

methods.name: BRC stride-8 quotient/remainder jet tail
capabilities: decompose the odd-N mod-8 sparse multiplier stream into five fixed-step residue orbits
seed every orbit with three exact Euclidean quotient samples, exactly fifteen divisions total
quadratically extrapolate the next quotient and recover the exact quotient/remainder by at most four signed denominator repairs
prove the quotient third-difference correction interval [-4,4] under the common linear tail and m>=962h
retain exact quotient remainder and bounded first/second finite-difference repair coordinates
avoid a fresh large-integer quotient division and generic quotient-times-denominator product after seeding
compose with the order-one linear BRC root closure and the staged square-gap residue cascade
provide an allocation-free in-place scan path for large-integer hot loops
operate without a multiplier-horizon table or upper multiplier bound
methods.core_law: For one fixed source residue class modulo 8, let q_m=floor(2hJ_m/(4m+h)) and rho_m be the exact Euclidean remainder. Consecutive visits differ by 8. Under 4m^5>=N and m>=962h, the smooth third-difference plus source-root phase has magnitude below one, while the floor phase contributes strictly between -4 and 4; hence epsilon=q_(m+8)-3q_m+3q_(m-8)-q_(m-16) lies in [-4,4]. Carrying rho and P=(Delta q+Delta^2 q)(D+32) yields the exact provisional residual S=rho+2h(J'-J)-32q-P, normalized by at most four additions/subtractions of D'=D+32. Five orbits times three samples require fifteen seed divisions; all later quotient states are exact recurrence states.
methods.hard_boundary: This extends t0.brc_linear_deep_tail and composes with t0.brc_square_gap_cascade; it is not a new top-level tool family. The proof controls exact multiplier-state transport only and does not shorten a Lehman/Hart-style search horizon or establish a factorization-complexity improvement. Finite Python benchmarks favor the jet only for sufficiently large integers (around 4096 bits in the committed environment); small-size routing should retain native division. The exact quotient remainder must not be collapsed to quotient-only or a fitted real trend.

methods.name: Weighted BRC CWM / log-multiplicity calculus
capabilities: exact positive-rational branch recoalescence and propagation through one CWM carrier
effective multiplicity E=W/M and symbolic BRC LN surplus readout
projective future scaling and incoming-weight compensation
one-state multi-loop exact recurrence and stable geometric closure
typed deterministic degeneration with E=1 and zero log surplus
methods.core_law: Positive finite branch systems carry CWM=(C,W,M) with alternative recoalescence (+,+,max) and serial propagation by componentwise multiplication; E=W/M and Delta=ln(E) measure multiplicity beyond the dominant path. Equal k-way recoalescence has Delta=ln k. For one-state loops total mass is stable iff S=sum q_i<1, not merely max q_i<1.
methods.hard_boundary: Positive Weighted-BRC does not represent signed/amplitude cancellation, does not recover erased branch provenance from Boolean support, does not make LN/LOG primitive state, and does not provide a general SCC/Perron-Frobenius/spectral-radius theorem. Deterministic single-path problems reduce to E=1, Delta=0 and should not be artificially reinterpreted as multiplicity problems.
